newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen rising marginally.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) were expected to rise on fresh buying when the market reopens on Saturday after the Friday Moslem weekend.
"Fresh commitments are likely in a rising market," said broker Shakil Rizvi. He said the recent reshuffling in the DSE council had greatly helped revive investor confidence.

Another broker said the blue chips in engineering and leather sectors like Bangladesh Oxygen, Olympic Industries, Bangladesh Lamps and Bata Shoe might draw buyers. The DSE index rose 28.59 points or 2.56 percent at 1,144.58 on turnover on Thursday. - Dhaka Newsroom + 880-2-506363
